_source: COPIED VERBATIM (the 'about' and 'vectors' keys below) from bonez-core libs/wire/contracts/computers/fixtures/plugin-tree.json at origin/main 71e4965cedb5. That file is the contract; this copy is what lets this repo's tests (and its Windows CI job) prove bin/bonez-package-hash.mjs and bin/bonez-plugin-push.mjs give the gateway's hash for the same bytes. Re-copy it when bonez-core changes the vectors; never edit a vector here.
about: The folder-plugin tree hash, pinned for every implementation that computes it: the gateway (computers/plugins.py tree_hash), the harness loader (libs/harness/src/pi/tree-hash.ts), the runner (services/agent-runner/src/tree-hash.ts) and ai-plugin's bin/bonez-package-hash.mjs. Each vector is an upload body ({path: base64}) and the tree hash every implementation must give it. 'hello' is the loader's original vector (computed with python hashlib); 'ordering' was hashed by bonez-package-hash.mjs and covers byte-order sorting ('dist/a.js' before 'dist/a/b.js', 'B' before 'a'), an empty file, non-UTF-8 bytes and a non-ASCII file body. 'ordering' is also a valid upload: the gateway tests upload it and the heartbeat fixture's ok_with_plugin reply describes it.
